verdict.rationale: HeyGen ships its own integrations with n8n, Make, HubSpot and Zapier, so video generation can be wired into trigger-driven workflows that run unattended. The batch API (up to 100 requests per call, with webhooks) supports asynchronous bulk jobs that complete without user attention. However, the evidence shows no native automation builder, scheduler, or recurring background-job feature inside HeyGen itself: the orchestration lives in third-party tools, and the API and webhooks are developer building blocks. missing for 10: native in-product automation or scheduling, documented background or recurring job runs without external orchestrators, independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous workflows.
